records.translation: ``label``과, 각 쌍 ``i < j``에 대해 다음 통계의 ``channel_<i>_channel_<j>_<stat>``:

records.context: ``spearman``: Spearman's rank correlation (average ranks of ties);
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation#4
records.source: ``spearman``: Spearman's rank correlation (average ranks of ties);
records.translation: ``spearman``: Spearman 순위 상관(동순위는 평균 순위);

records.context: ``icq``: Li et al.'s (2004) intensity correlation quotient, the share of pixels where both image data channels sit on the same side of their object means, minus 0.5 (-0.5 to 0.5);
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation#5
records.source: ``icq``: Li et al.'s (2004) intensity correlation quotient, the share of pixels where both channels sit on the same side of their object means, minus 0.5 (-0.5 to 0.5);
records.translation: ``icq``: Li et al.(2004)의 강도 상관 지수로, 두 채널이 모두 각자의 객체 평균의 같은 쪽에 있는 픽셀의 비율에서 0.5를 뺀 값입니다(-0.5에서 0.5);

records.context: ``k1``, ``k2``: Manders et al.'s (1993) split overlap coefficients ``sum(a b) / sum(a^2)`` and ``sum(a b) / sum(b^2)``;
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation#6
records.source: ``k1``, ``k2``: Manders et al.'s (1993) split overlap coefficients ``sum(a b) / sum(a^2)`` and ``sum(a b) / sum(b^2)``;
records.translation: ``k1``, ``k2``: Manders et al.(1993)의 분할 중첩 계수 ``sum(a b) / sum(a^2)`` 및 ``sum(a b) / sum(b^2)``;

records.context: ``rwc1``, ``rwc2``: Singan et al.'s (2011) rank-weighted colocalisation, ``sum(a w) / sum(a)`` over the pixels where both channels are above background, ``w = (R - |rank_i - rank_j|) / R`` with dense ranks within the object and ``R`` their maximum.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation#7
records.source: ``rwc1``, ``rwc2``: Singan et al.'s (2011) rank-weighted colocalisation, ``sum(a w) / sum(a)`` over the pixels where both channels are above background, ``w = (R - |rank_i - rank_j|) / R`` with dense ranks within the object and ``R`` their maximum.
records.translation: ``rwc1``, ``rwc2``: Singan et al.(2011)의 순위 가중 공동국재로, 두 채널이 모두 배경보다 높은 픽셀에 대한 ``sum(a w) / sum(a)``이며, ``w = (R - |rank_i - rank_j|) / R``에서 순위는 객체 안의 조밀 순위이고 ``R``은 그 최댓값입니다.

records.context: ``a`` and ``b`` are the channels minus their background, with the background each channel's ``median + 3 * 1.4826 * MAD`` in the object -- the background, and so the pixels, of spaCR's ``manders_m1``, ``manders_m2`` and ``manders_overlap_coefficient`` (``calculate_correlation``), which these complete. ``k1``, ``k2``, ``rwc1`` and ``rwc2`` are 0 when a channel has nothing above background, as the Manders columns are.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation#8
records.source: ``a`` and ``b`` are the channels minus their background, with the background each channel's ``median + 3 * 1.4826 * MAD`` in the object -- the background, and so the pixels, of spaCR's ``manders_m1``, ``manders_m2`` and ``manders_overlap_coefficient`` (``calculate_correlation``), which these complete. ``k1``, ``k2``, ``rwc1`` and ``rwc2`` are 0 when a channel has nothing above background, as the Manders columns are.
records.translation: ``a``와 ``b``는 배경을 뺀 채널이며, 각 채널의 배경은 객체 안에서의 ``median + 3 * 1.4826 * MAD``입니다 -- 이는 spaCR의 ``manders_m1``, ``manders_m2``, ``manders_overlap_coefficient``(``calculate_correlation``)와 같은 배경, 따라서 같은 픽셀이며, 이 값들은 그 열들을 보완합니다. 채널에 배경보다 높은 값이 없으면 ``k1``, ``k2``, ``rwc1``, ``rwc2``는 Manders 열과 마찬가지로 0입니다.

records.translation: ``label``; 채널별 ``channel_<i>_puncta_count``(객체 안에서 배경보다 높은 8-연결 반점 수)와 ``channel_<i>_puncta_area_fraction``(객체 픽셀 중 배경보다 높은 비율); 그리고 각 쌍 ``i < j``에 대해 다음 통계의 ``channel_<i>_channel_<j>_<stat>``:

records.context: ``nmi``: mutual information of the two channels' within-object quantile ranks (``bins`` x ``bins``) over ``log(bins)``, which sees dependence Pearson and Spearman miss;
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation_extra#7
records.source: ``nmi``: mutual information of the two channels' within-object quantile ranks (``bins`` x ``bins``) over ``log(bins)``, which sees dependence Pearson and Spearman miss;
records.translation: ``nmi``: 두 채널의 객체 내 분위수 순위(``bins`` x ``bins``)의 상호 정보량을 ``log(bins)``로 나눈 값으로, Pearson과 Spearman이 놓치는 의존성을 포착합니다;

records.context: ``costes_m1``, ``costes_m2``: Manders' M1 and M2 at Costes et al.'s (2004) automatic thresholds, found by bisection as CellProfiler 4's faster mode does;
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation_extra#8
records.source: ``costes_m1``, ``costes_m2``: Manders' M1 and M2 at Costes et al.'s (2004) automatic thresholds, found by bisection as CellProfiler 4's faster mode does;
records.translation: ``costes_m1``, ``costes_m2``: Costes et al.(2004)의 자동 임계값에서의 Manders M1과 M2로, 임계값은 CellProfiler 4의 빠른 모드처럼 이분법으로 찾습니다;

records.context: ``puncta_overlap_ij``, ``puncta_overlap_ji``: Lachmanovich et al.'s (2003) object-based colocalisation, the share of channel ``i``'s spots whose centroid falls on above-background pixels of channel ``j``, and the reverse; 0 without spots.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_colocalisation_extra#9
records.source: ``puncta_overlap_ij``, ``puncta_overlap_ji``: Lachmanovich et al.'s (2003) object-based colocalisation, the share of channel ``i``'s spots whose centroid falls on above-background pixels of channel ``j``, and the reverse; 0 without spots.
records.translation: ``puncta_overlap_ij``, ``puncta_overlap_ji``: Lachmanovich et al.(2003)의 객체 기반 공동국재로, 채널 ``i``의 반점 중 중심점이 채널 ``j``의 배경보다 높은 픽셀에 놓이는 비율과 그 반대입니다; 반점이 없으면 0입니다.

records.context: ``label`` and ``channel_<i>_channel_<j>_costes_m1`` and ``_costes_m2`` per pair ``i < j``, the values :func:`measure_colocalisation_extra` writes with ``costes=True``: the orthogonal-regression line per object, its thresholds lowered by bisection (CellProfiler 4's faster mode) until the pixels below either threshold stop correlating, and M1 and M2 over the pixels above both; 0 where the line has no positive slope.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_costes#4
records.source: ``label`` and ``channel_<i>_channel_<j>_costes_m1`` and ``_costes_m2`` per pair ``i < j``, the values :func:`measure_colocalisation_extra` writes with ``costes=True``: the orthogonal-regression line per object, its thresholds lowered by bisection (CellProfiler 4's faster mode) until the pixels below either threshold stop correlating, and M1 and M2 over the pixels above both; 0 where the line has no positive slope.
records.translation: ``label``과 ``channel_<i>_channel_<j>_costes_m1`` 및 ``_costes_m2``(각 쌍 ``i < j``마다)로, :func:`measure_colocalisation_extra`가 ``costes=True``일 때 기록하는 값입니다: 객체마다 직교 회귀선을 구하고, 어느 한 임계값 아래의 픽셀이 더 이상 상관되지 않을 때까지 그 임계값을 이분법(CellProfiler 4의 빠른 모드)으로 낮춘 뒤, 두 임계값보다 모두 높은 픽셀에서 M1과 M2를 계산합니다; 회귀선의 기울기가 양수가 아니면 0입니다.

records.context: The edge is CellProfiler's (MeasureObjectIntensity, ``*IntensityEdge``): the object pixels with a 4-connected neighbour outside the object, including the microscope field of view border, so a cell touching another cell has its edge there too, and a ring's inner boundary is edge. ``std`` is the population standard deviation.

records.translation: 가장자리는 CellProfiler의 정의(MeasureObjectIntensity, ``*IntensityEdge``)를 따릅니다: 4-연결 이웃 중 하나가 객체 밖에 있는 객체 픽셀이며, 시야 경계도 포함합니다. 따라서 다른 세포와 맞닿은 세포는 그 자리에도 가장자리가 있고, 고리의 안쪽 경계도 가장자리입니다. ``std``는 모집단 표준편차입니다.

records.translation: ``label``과, 채널별로 주파수 인덱스 ``f``와 방향 인덱스 ``o``마다 ``channel_<i>_gabor_f<f>_o<o>_mean`` 및 ``_std``: 객체 전체에서 응답 크기의 평균과 표준편차이며, 각각 객체의 평균 강도로 나누어 이 블록이 밝기가 아닌 텍스처를 담도록 합니다(그 평균이 양수가 아니면 NaN).

records.context: The kernels are :func:`skimage.filters.gabor_kernel` (bandwidth 1), convolved with the whole microscope field of view by overlap-add (:func:`scipy.signal.oaconvolve`), so each object's response sees its surroundings within about one wavelength of its edge.

records.source: The kernels are :func:`skimage.filters.gabor_kernel` (bandwidth 1), convolved with the whole field by overlap-add (:func:`scipy.signal.oaconvolve`), so each object's response sees its surroundings within about one wavelength of its edge.
records.translation: 커널은 :func:`skimage.filters.gabor_kernel`(대역폭 1)이며, 중첩-가산 방식(:func:`scipy.signal.oaconvolve`)으로 시야 전체와 합성곱하므로 각 객체의 응답에는 가장자리에서 약 한 파장 이내의 주변이 반영됩니다.

records.context: sieve the microscope field of view scaled by this factor (bilinear), as CellProfiler's image sample size; 0.25 is CellProfiler's default and about 16 times faster. ``background_radius`` and each step are then in subsampled pixels, so a step removes structures about ``k / subsample`` full pixels in radius. The background subtraction and every reconstruction are scaled back to the full microscope field of view before each object is averaged, so small objects keep their values. 1.0, the default, sieves at full resolution.

records.source: sieve the field scaled by this factor (bilinear), as CellProfiler's image sample size; 0.25 is CellProfiler's default and about 16 times faster. ``background_radius`` and each step are then in subsampled pixels, so a step removes structures about ``k / subsample`` full pixels in radius. The background subtraction and every reconstruction are scaled back to the full field before each object is averaged, so small objects keep their values. 1.0, the default, sieves at full resolution.
records.translation: 시야를 이 배율로 (쌍선형) 축소해 체거름하며, CellProfiler의 이미지 샘플 크기와 같습니다; 0.25는 CellProfiler의 기본값이며 약 16배 빠릅니다. 이때 ``background_radius``와 각 단계는 축소된 픽셀 단위이므로, 한 단계는 원래 픽셀 기준 반지름이 약 ``k / subsample``인 구조를 제거합니다. 배경 차감과 모든 재구성은 각 객체를 평균하기 전에 원래 시야 크기로 되돌려지므로 작은 객체도 값을 유지합니다. 기본값 1.0은 원래 해상도로 체거름합니다.

records.context: As CellProfiler's MeasureGranularity (Maragos 1989 pattern spectrum): the microscope field of view less its opening by a disc of ``background_radius``, then repeated erosion by a 3 x 3 cross, each followed by grey reconstruction under the microscope field of view; the per-object mean of each reconstruction gives the spectrum. Objects with no intensity left after the background get NaN.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_granularity#7
records.source: As CellProfiler's MeasureGranularity (Maragos 1989 pattern spectrum): the field less its opening by a disc of ``background_radius``, then repeated erosion by a 3 x 3 cross, each followed by grey reconstruction under the field; the per-object mean of each reconstruction gives the spectrum. records.context: CellProfiler's MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution with no centre objects: the centre is the point farthest from the edge (the median of ties), and a pixel's ring comes from its distance to the centre over that plus its distance to the edge, so every ring follows the outline. A ring with no pixels -- the innermost ring of a cytoplasm, whose centre lies in the nucleus -- has ``frac_at_d`` 0 and ``mean_frac`` and ``radial_cv`` 0 rather than NaN, so the column is not dropped as incomplete. An object with no intensity has NaN fractions.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_radial_distribution#5
records.source: CellProfiler's MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution with no centre objects: the centre is the point farthest from the edge (the median of ties), and a pixel's ring comes from its distance to the centre over that plus its distance to the edge, so every ring follows the outline. Holes belong to no ring but shape the edge distance of the filled object. A ring with no pixels -- the innermost ring of a cytoplasm, whose centre lies in the nucleus -- has ``frac_at_d`` 0 and ``mean_frac`` and ``radial_cv`` 0 rather than NaN, so the column is not dropped as incomplete. An object with no intensity has NaN fractions.
records.translation: 중심 객체가 없는 CellProfiler의 MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution입니다: 중심은 가장자리에서 가장 먼 점(동률이면 그 중앙값)이고, 픽셀의 고리는 중심까지의 거리를 그 거리와 가장자리까지의 거리의 합으로 나눈 값으로 정해지므로 모든 고리가 윤곽을 따릅니다. 구멍은 어떤 고리에도 속하지 않지만 채워진 객체의 가장자리 거리를 결정합니다. 픽셀이 없는 고리 -- 중심이 핵 안에 있는 세포질의 가장 안쪽 고리 -- 는 ``frac_at_d``가 0이고 ``mean_frac``과 ``radial_cv``도 NaN이 아닌 0이므로, 열이 불완전하다는 이유로 제거되지 않습니다. 강도가 없는 객체는 비율이 NaN입니다.

records.context: The features are the ones spaCR's measure writes -- morphology from :func:`spacr.measure._morphological_measurements`, intensity and texture from :func:`spacr.measure._intensity_measurements` -- so an OPS cell and a measured well's cell carry the same columns and nothing is re-derived. The cytoplasm is the cell minus its nucleus, under the cell's label. The object labels the colocalisation block carries (``*_label_correlation``) are left out, as spaCR's database write leaves them out, so no column repeats the label.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field#12
records.source: The features are the ones spaCR's measure writes -- morphology from :func:`spacr.measure._morphological_measurements`, intensity and texture from :func:`spacr.measure._intensity_measurements` -- so an OPS cell and a measured well's cell carry the same columns and nothing is re-derived. The cytoplasm is the cell minus its nucleus, under the cell's label. The object labels the colocalisation block carries (``*_label_correlation``) are left out, as spaCR's database write leaves them out, so no column repeats the label.
records.translation: 특징은 spaCR의 measure가 기록하는 것과 같습니다 -- 형태는 :func:`spacr.measure._morphological_measurements`, 강도와 텍스처는 :func:`spacr.measure._intensity_measurements`에서 나옵니다 -- 따라서 OPS 세포와 측정된 웰의 세포는 같은 열을 가지며 아무것도 다시 유도하지 않습니다. 세포질은 세포에서 핵을 뺀 영역이며 세포의 레이블을 씁니다. 공동국재 블록에 들어 있는 객체 레이블(``*_label_correlation``)은 spaCR의 데이터베이스 기록에서처럼 제외하므로 어떤 열도 레이블을 반복하지 않습니다.
